root_causes.description: AR exceptions totaling $2.6M are driven by incomplete or inaccurate invoice data and reconciliation errors.
Bank duplicates caused by insufficient validation checks during data import processes.
AP exceptions linked to system integration issues causing mismatches in vendor payment data.

remediations.action: Implement enhanced reconciliation processes for AR to ensure invoice accuracy and completeness.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in AR exceptions below materiality thresholds (<$50K).

remediations.action: Introduce duplicate detection algorithms during bank data import processes.
remediations.success_criteria: Elimination of duplicate transactions in bank reconciliation reports.

remediations.action: Conduct system integration testing and resolve vendor payment data mismatches in AP workflows.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in AP exceptions to <$50K and improved vendor payment accuracy.
